Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 27  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that "Uncharted Seas" has the younger director due to an error in reasoning. While all data was correctly gathered (Wesley Ruggles, born 1889, directed *Uncharted Seas*; Richard Brooks, born 1912, directed *Something of Value*), the comparison of their ages at the time of their respective films' releases was irrelevant to the task. The original query asked which film had the younger director, based on birth years, not age at the time of release. This misinterpretation of the task objective led to the wrong final answer. The task required comparing birth years directly, which clearly shows Richard Brooks (1912) was younger than Wesley Ruggles (1889). This type of error aligns with **logical misinterpretation of the task requirement**.
